test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace.

2. Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge.

3. As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before.

4. Technology has revolutionized education.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins with **Sentence 4**, which introduces the central idea that technology has revolutionized education. 
 
• **Sentence 2 comes next**, as it elaborates on the impact of technology by highlighting the accessibility of global knowledge through online platforms: 
 
 
• "Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 follows**, building on the benefits of online platforms by emphasizing flexibility in learning: 
 
 
• "They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 concludes** the paragraph by summarizing the broader implications of these advancements: 
 
 
• "As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before." 
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **4-2-1-3**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Technology has revolutionized education. Online learning platforms provide students with access to global knowledge. They also offer flexibility in learning at one's own pace. As a result, students today have more learning opportunities than ever before."</div
